title: Security Engineering
tagline: SOC analysis, penetration testing, network perimeter defense, application security, PKI, and incident response.
description: Master defense-in-depth security principles across entry-level, intermediate, and experienced roles. Covers threat modeling, OWASP Top 10, TCP/IP attacks, cryptographic ciphers, SIEM analytics, micro-segmentation, and enterprise system hardening.
source_license: Public Open Source (GitHub Terms of Service)

categories.name: Cybersecurity Fundamentals & Threat Taxonomy
categories.description: Core cybersecurity roles, common attack vectors, authentication attacks, and threat classifications.

categories.name: Network Security, Protocols & Perimeter Defenses
categories.description: TCP/IP handshakes, ARP spoofing, firewalls, IDS/IPS, DNS security, and volumetric DDoS defense.

categories.name: Cryptography, PKI, IAM & Key Lifecycle
categories.description: Symmetric and asymmetric encryption, key lifecycle management (NIST SP 800-57), PKI certificates, and IAM access controls.

categories.name: Application Security, Injection Attacks & Web Exploits
categories.description: OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, SQL injection, XSS, CSRF, browser security headers, and secure coding practices.

categories.name: Enterprise Architecture, System Hardening & Advanced Threats
categories.description: Zero Trust network architecture, MITRE ATT&CK kill chains, Linux/Windows endpoint hardening, and container security.

categories.name: Incident Response, SOC Operations, SIEM & Threat Hunting
categories.description: SOC alert triage, SIEM correlation rules, incident response containment protocols, and memory/disk forensics.
